body:
Part of #2390.

## Problem

The controller has no live chat events and no way to fetch a chat transcript, so it cannot build a chat view for a remote agent. The satellite already broadcasts the events; the controller drops them.

## Established (origin/main 91da2bc6)

- Satellite broadcasts every chat event: `annex-server.ts:2758-2761` (`broadcastAndBuffer('chat:event', { agentId, event })`), also pushed into the replay ring (`annex-server.ts:782-786`).
- Controller main forwards it only through the catch-all: `annex-client.ts:633-636` (`default:` → `broadcastSatelliteEvent`). There is no explicit `chat:event` case in `annex-client.ts:619-631`.
- Controller renderer ignores it: `src/renderer/stores/annexClientStore.ts:350-428` handles `snapshot`, `pty:data`, `hook:event`, `agent:status`, `agent:woken`, `agent:spawned`, `pty:exit`, `canvas:state` and later group-project types. No `chat:event` branch.
- The desktop controller never sends `{ type: 'replay' }`. `annex-client.ts` contains no `replay` request; it relies on a fresh snapshot plus `/buffer` after reconnect. The server-side replay (`annex-server.ts:2236-2270`) is used only by other clients.
- On agent exit the satellite clears the agent's replay entries (`annex-server.ts:2771`, `eventReplay.clearForAgent`).
- There is no Annex route for the Clubhouse chat transcript. `/api/v1/agents/:id/sessions` and `/sessions/:sid/transcript` (`annex-server.ts:1613-1660`) read the provider's own session files through `provider.readSessionTranscript`, which is a different format from the stamped `ChatEvent` stream.
- The satellite can produce a backfill cheaply: `ChatAgentRuntime.readTranscript({ tail, afterSeq })` (`chat-runtime.ts:761-769`) returns stamped events with `lastSeq`; `listChatSessions` and `readChatTranscript` (`chat-transcript.ts`) work for sleeping agents too, which is what the local `IPC.CHAT.READ_TRANSCRIPT` / `LIST_SESSIONS` handlers use (`chat-handlers.ts:131-138`).
- Protocol version is strict equality: `annex-client.ts:595` disconnects with "Incompatible Annex version" when `protocolVersion !== ANNEX_PROTOCOL_VERSION` (`shared/types.ts:1005`, currently 2).

## Proposed approach

1. `annex-client.ts`: add an explicit `chat:event` case that forwards to the renderer (no caching in main needed once the backfill route exists).
2. Satellite routes (authenticated, read-only, so bearer or mTLS):
   - `GET /api/v1/agents/:id/chat/sessions` → `listChatSessions(agentId)`.
   - `GET /api/v1/agents/:id/chat/transcript?sessionId=&tail=&afterSeq=` → `readChatTranscript`, bounded `tail` (for example 500) and a byte cap.
3. Controller IPC + preload: `annexClient.chatTranscript(satelliteId, agentId, opts)` and `chatSessions(...)`.
4. Ordering: chat events carry `sessionId` and `seq`. The controller buffers live `chat:event`s for an agent while its backfill request is in flight, then applies the backfill and drops buffered events with `seq <= lastSeq` of the same session. This avoids the double-draw race #2324 describes for terminals.
5. Versioning: do not bump `ANNEX_PROTOCOL_VERSION` (that would disconnect every older satellite). Add an additive field to the snapshot, for example `capabilities: { chat: 1 }`. A controller that sees no chat capability keeps the placeholder from #2391.

## Speculation (not verified)

- `chat:event` includes every `agent_message_chunk` / `agent_thought_chunk`. These share the 10,000-event / 1-hour replay ring with `pty:data` (`annex-event-replay.ts:26-27`) and may evict terminal replay for iOS clients on a busy satellite. Worth measuring; options are coalescing chunks on the satellite or keeping chunk events out of the replay ring once backfill exists.
- Tool events can carry large `rawOutput`. Each is sent to every connected client, iOS included. A size cap or truncation for Annex may be needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- With a controller connected, chat events for a remote agent reach the renderer as a typed event (`satelliteId`, namespaced `agentId`, `ChatEvent`).
- A controller that connects mid-session, or reconnects after a drop, receives the transcript for the current session and then live events with no duplicates and no gap (unit test with an interleaved backfill and live stream).
- Sessions list works for sleeping agents.
- An older satellite (no `capabilities.chat`) still connects and the controller falls back to the placeholder.
- The new routes reject unauthenticated requests (401), and take only an agent id, session id and numbers: no path parameters.

## Dependencies

None for the protocol work. The renderer consumer is #2393.
title: [MEDIUM] Annex: forward chat:event to the controller and add chat transcript backfill with seq
